basic_info.description: Discover the perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience in this beautiful Inner Richmond home! The sun-drenched top level features a charming mudroom, intricate moldings, inlaid wood floors, and effortless flow to the deep, enchanting yard. Through the doorway is the formal dining room with elegant bay windows, and cozy gas fireplace. Seamlessly connected is the living room. The gourmet kitchen boasts a high-end 6-burner gas stove, and double ovens. Adjacent to the kitchen is a light-filled breakfast nook with French doors that open onto a deck overlooking the lush, private yard and mature palm tree. The primary bedroom also features French doors leading to the same deck, offering easy indoor-outdoor flow. The second bedroom and spacious bathroom with a classic clawfoot tub completes this level. The lower level offers its own private entrance, opening to a versatile open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area. The primary bedroom includes a separate office space, perfect for working from home. The second bedroom provides direct access to the yard. The attached garage includes a convenient w/d. Superb Inner Richmond location, steps to Golden Gate Park & Rossi Park, Clement St. & Balboa St shops & restaurants. The perfect blend of urban convenience and tranquil living!
